name: confirmation-nested-dialog
title: Confirmation nested in a dialog
description: Confirmation nested in a dialog. Core/Overlays & Menus/Dialog pattern composed from @gaudi/design-system/core/Dialog and other public Gaudi components; the components stay package imports.
docs: Copy-in pattern built on @gaudi/design-system; the components stay package imports. Load '@gaudi/design-system/global.css' once and add transpilePackages: ['@gaudi/design-system'] in Next.js. Until the package is on npm, install it from GitHub first: pnpm add github:ahmadassaf/design-system.

files.content:
import {
  DialogConfirmationRoot as DialogConfirmation,
  DialogConfirmationAction,
  DialogConfirmationCancel,
  DialogConfirmationContent,
  DialogConfirmationDescription,
  DialogConfirmationFooter,
  DialogConfirmationHeader,
  DialogConfirmationTitle,
  DialogConfirmationTrigger
} from '@gaudi/design-system/core/Dialog';
import { default as Button } from '@gaudi/design-system/core/Button';
import {
  DialogRoot as Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogTrigger
} from '@gaudi/design-system/core/Dialog';
export function Pattern() {
  return (
    <Dialog>
      <DialogTrigger asChild>
        <Button variant='outline'>Open Dialog</Button>
      </DialogTrigger>
      <DialogContent>
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Alert Dialog Example</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            Click the button below to open an alert dialog.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <DialogFooter>
          <DialogConfirmation>
            <DialogConfirmationTrigger asChild>
              <Button>Open Confirmation Dialog</Button>
            </DialogConfirmationTrigger>
            <DialogConfirmationContent size='sm'>
              <DialogConfirmationHeader>
                <DialogConfirmationTitle>Are you absolutely sure?</DialogConfirmationTitle>
                <DialogConfirmationDescription>
                  This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete
                  your account and remove your data from our servers.
                </DialogConfirmationDescription>
              </DialogConfirmationHeader>
              <DialogConfirmationFooter>
                <DialogConfirmationCancel>Cancel</DialogConfirmationCancel>
                <DialogConfirmationAction>Continue</DialogConfirmationAction>
              </DialogConfirmationFooter>
            </DialogConfirmationContent>
          </DialogConfirmation>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
